description: Rb₂NaZn₂H₅(C₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Rb is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to one H and nine O atoms. The Rb-H bond length is 2.96 Å. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.18 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.64 Å. Zn is bonded in a trigonal bipyramidal geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.27 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.28 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both H-O bond lengths are 1.21 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.59 Å) H-O bond length. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Rb and two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) H-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Zn, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Zn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Rb, one Zn, and two H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Zn, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one C, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Rb, one C, and one H atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Zn, one C, and one H atom.
